response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering skills across multiple languages and domains, including C/C++ experience from National Instruments and low-latency systems with DLang at Dunnhumby. However, his recent work focuses heavily on JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js, with limited exposure to modern C++ or Rust in the last 5+ years. His geospatial experience with GISCollective is relevant but leans toward web-based solutions rather than routing pipeline optimization. The mismatch between his current stack and the role's requirements raises concerns about immediate ramp-up time.
strengths: Strong low-latency systems experience with DLang and asynchronous I/O at Dunnhumby
Proven expertise in geospatial data processing through GISCollective
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and contribute across the stack
concerns: Limited modern C++/Rust experience in recent roles (last C++ role was 2014-2015)
Geospatial work primarily web-based rather than routing pipeline optimization
Recent focus on JavaScript/TypeScript may indicate a skills gap for the core technology requirements
